comparison: Surprise Pareto winner among non-NS alternative optimizers: achieves 12/15 PASS with 0 tensor state/param and 0 matmuls, outperforming 1-state Lion-MP (10/14), O(m+n) Adafactor-MP (11/15), 2-state Adam-MP (9/15), and 1-state Optimistic Polar (8/14), while trailing unified-v11 (16/16) on grid100 sustained suffix, DDGAN conditional fiber, and tanh rail escape.
conclusion: Zero-state smooth SignSGD-MP (u = g / hypot(|g|, s_eff), L_infinity geometry, 0 parameter-sized state tensors, 0 NS) + MP + secant band achieves 12/15 executed PASS (3 numerical FAIL, 0 TIMEOUT, 1 prereq-gated grid100_mlp16) on r4-occam-ablation-v1, tying law4-muon-m as the top alternative optimizer and beating 1-state Lion (10/14), sublinear Adafactor (11/15), and 2-state Adam (9/15)! Passes five_word_joint_smoke (5/5, qf=1.0, tv=0.01895, recon=1, min_tok=0.9998), gaussian1d_smoke/stability (ks=0.0264), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), ring16 (hq=0.9685, eig=0.5125), vector_unequal_mass/width (eig=0.6072/0.3832), both >500x Nash tasks (hq=0.9421/0.9731), and BOTH t3_iso probes (scale_mass_8x eig=0.4993, saddle_shift hq=0.9453). Fails only grid100 (final prec=0.9930, ctr=0.0983 yet missed live suffix), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0_mean=0.5286), and zero_tanh_rail_escape (mae=0.00591).
